comment: interp-engine's canonical point registry, pinned for the interp-engine generation of alias_report and its points-file writer. Copied from the source named below, never inferred: points (name, scope) from interp_engine/points.py POINTS and HYPER_CONNECTION_POINTS, the address grammar from interp_engine/address.py. A point with no_torchlens_site is reported structurally absent with that reason; every other point has a translation.json row of generation interp-engine. facets_without_point gives the reason a torchlens tensor facet has no interp-engine point.

points.name: q_norm_in
points.no_torchlens_site: torchlens has no facet for a query/key norm (QK-norm families such as Qwen3 and Gemma-3); read the attention's q or k facet, which is the projection before any QK norm

points.name: q_norm_out
points.no_torchlens_site: torchlens has no facet for a query/key norm (QK-norm families such as Qwen3 and Gemma-3); read the attention's q or k facet, which is the projection before any QK norm

points.name: k_norm_in
points.no_torchlens_site: torchlens has no facet for a query/key norm (QK-norm families such as Qwen3 and Gemma-3); read the attention's q or k facet, which is the projection before any QK norm

points.name: k_norm_out
points.no_torchlens_site: torchlens has no facet for a query/key norm (QK-norm families such as Qwen3 and Gemma-3); read the attention's q or k facet, which is the projection before any QK norm

points.name: attn_gate
points.no_torchlens_site: torchlens has no facet for a gated attention's double-width query projection

points.name: attn_out_post
points.no_torchlens_site: torchlens has no facet for the output of a post-attention norm (sandwich-norm families such as Gemma-2 and OLMo-2); where the family has no such norm interp-engine serves the raw output here, so read attn_out.{L}

points.name: router_logits
points.no_torchlens_site: torchlens has no facet for MoE routing (router logits, selected experts, expert weights); trace the router module and read its outputs by op label

points.name: expert_weights
points.no_torchlens_site: torchlens has no facet for MoE routing (router logits, selected experts, expert weights); trace the router module and read its outputs by op label

points.name: expert_indices
points.no_torchlens_site: torchlens has no facet for MoE routing (router logits, selected experts, expert weights); trace the router module and read its outputs by op label

points.name: mlp_out_post
points.no_torchlens_site: torchlens has no facet for the output of a post-MLP norm (sandwich-norm families such as Gemma-2 and OLMo-2); where the family has no such norm interp-engine serves the raw output here, so read mlp_out.{L}

points.name: final_norm
points.no_torchlens_site: torchlens records the final norm's input (final_norm_input) and the logits but has no facet for the final norm's output

points.name: resid_streams
points.no_torchlens_site: torchlens has no facet for a hyper-connection trunk's parallel residual streams (DeepSeek-V4 style mHC); resid_pre and resid_post are single-stream sites

facets_without_point.q: interp-engine has no point for the query projection; it names q only after a QK norm (q_norm_out), on QK-norm families
facets_without_point.k: interp-engine has no point for the key projection; it names k only after a QK norm (k_norm_out), on QK-norm families
facets_without_point.result: interp-engine has no point for per-head residual contributions; its capture.head_contributions helper computes them from z
facets_without_point.gated_out: interp-engine has no point for a gated MLP's activated gate; mlp_act is the product with the up projection
facets_without_point.down_out: interp-engine has no point for the down projection's own output; mlp_out is the MLP module's output
facets_without_point.normalized: interp-engine has no per-norm points (a norm's scale is not a point); attn_in and mlp_in are the sublayers' inputs
facets_without_point.inv_rms: interp-engine has no per-norm points (a norm's scale is not a point)
facets_without_point.indices: token ids, not an activation; interp-engine takes them as the prompt
facets_without_point.final_norm_input: interp-engine has no point for the final norm's input
